title: WhatsApp invitation handoff: automated and layout checks passed
summary: WhatsApp composer, HTTPS handoff, paste-link recovery, consent and view-only regression checks passed locally. Publication, APK installation and real two-phone testing remain outstanding.

changes.detail: Verified handoff tests cover correct WhatsApp message encoding, unavailable-WhatsApp share-sheet fallback, received-link validation, credential-free HTTP URLs, explicit native consent, one-device handoff and no viewer input.
Documented exact website files to publish and Android/sign-in/Tailscale requirements; no deployment or installation is claimed.

validation.name: TypeScript
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck completed with exit 0.

validation.name: Interaction, protocol-client and history regression checks
validation.detail: 23 tests passed for invitation web handoff, invitation component, phone page, direct viewer and change-history UI/archive. Expanded received-link and WhatsApp-fallback checks plus resume-route protection passed in a subsequent 4-test run (24 distinct tests overall). Native host protocol sources were unchanged in this update.

validation.name: Mobile landing layout
validation.detail: Headless installed Chrome rendered local routed fixtures at 320px English, 430px French and 390px Arabic without horizontal overflow or page errors. Arabic screenshot visually inspected. Screenshots saved under artifacts/phone-whatsapp-{en,fr,ar}.png. Initial bundled Playwright Chromium launch was unavailable; installed Chrome succeeded. These are fixtures, not a live site preview.

validation.name: Publication and real devices
validation.detail: No website deployment, APK build or installation. The HTTPS page must be published on lecomax.com and updated Learn installed on both signed-in Android phones with Tailscale. Physical WhatsApp/in-app-browser launch, screen permission and live two-phone capture still need testing.
